rows.grounds: compound object of nirvartya; accusative singular neuter
absolutive/gerund governing the preceding accusative object

items.question: After performing its anga-homa, what should be offered to Kurukullā with the pavitra?
premises: The anga-homa must be performed first.
items.inference: Perform the anga-homa, then offer with the pavitra.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tad- (its) is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: After performing its anga-homa, one should offer with the pavitra.
